rationale.edition: Checked the complete changed-file list in changed_files.txt: both paths are under web/src/ (web/src/components/settings/index.vue and web/src/components/settings/index.spec.ts). No paths under enterprise/, o2_enterprise/, or src/enterprise/. The diff prose mentions enterprise-only meta-org pages and config.isEnterprise, but those are just string/code references inside OSS-owned files; path evidence is authoritative, so edition = oss.
rationale.skip: Not skipped. trigger_comment.txt is empty and no tests-added/opt-out label was supplied, so there is no explicit opt-out. The change touches a real Vue component (settings/index.vue) and alters navigation redirect behavior, so it is a user-facing behavior change, not a docs-only/CI-only/comment-only change.
rationale.e2e: E2E is warranted. The change adds query_management to the set of enterprise-only settings pages (nodes, license, passwordPolicy) that redirect to /settings/general when the current org is not the meta org (or on a non-enterprise build). This is a user-facing navigation/routing interaction that can be verified in a real browser by navigating to the query_management settings route and asserting the redirect (and asserting no redirect inside the meta org).
rationale.area: The change lives in web/src/components/settings/. Settings-related E2E specs are housed under the GeneralTests folder (e.g. settings-form-validation.spec.js), so GeneralTests is the closest area for this settings navigation behavior.
rationale.group: GeneralTests is the general/misc shard (actual_folder GeneralTests) that already carries settings-related and enterprise-overlay specs (settings-form-validation, cipherKeys, logoManagement). The new settings navigation spec belongs in this shard rather than GeneralTests-Forms, which is reserved for form-validation specs.
rationale.existing_tests: No E2E specs in the diff. The only test file changed is web/src/components/settings/index.spec.ts, which is a Vitest unit test under web/src/, not a Playwright E2E spec under tests/ui-testing/playwright-tests/.
